caption: Two identical Spearmen lines face an identical cavalry charge. The right line is ordered to Brace (Ctrl+F4) early, so it settles well before contact; the left line is left at the merely-engaged default. soldier_brace() is no longer binary: the braced line holds its ground almost exactly (its position barely shifts on contact), while the unbraced line visibly presses forward into the melee -- the same graded value also raises its knockback/knockdown resistance and its weapon-differentiated brace capacity (issue #1105).
